title: Malaysian-Style Fried Rice
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make fried rice dish inspired by Malaysian cuisine, perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: aromatic oil
ingredients.notes: such as vegetable or canola oil

ingredients.name: fry
ingredients.notes: diced, such as shallots or scallions

instructions: Heat the aromatic oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the hot sauce and smoked paprika, and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the diced bananas and fry until they start to caramelize, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the cooked rice to the skillet or wok, breaking up any clumps with a spatula.
Stir-fry the rice with the bananas and spices for about 5 minutes, until everything is well combined.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed, then serve hot.
Optional: garnish with additional fry and serve immediately.
